title: Class Overview — What We Will Learn Today
lead: A <u>simple, step-by-step class on Percentage and on Profit and Loss</u>. These two chapters decide a big part of your Quantitative Aptitude score, so we will learn them slowly and clearly.
roadmap: What happens when a number changes by one percent, and then changes again by another percent. We learn the easy formula and why it works.
Two questions, each with a short explanation in plain words.
exam: Why it matters: the same idea comes back in Data Interpretation questions and in Simple and Compound Interest questions, so learning it well saves you time later.
